current.text: Oklahoma City traded him to Atlanta this offseason. He comes off the Hawks bench.
He is likely the seventh man in a 10-man rotation. The five starters are McCollum, Alexander-Walker, Daniels, Johnson and Okongwu, and Dort, Landale and Flemings are also on the bench.
He fits better than Lu Dort as a backup 2/3 and is the better shooter. He could pass Dort in minutes by the end of the season.
He finished outside the top 250 last season.
Lloyd says Yahoo ranks him too high and that his good reputation from OKC was somewhat unfounded.
Several Atlanta starters handle the ball, so Wiggins or Dort can step in for any of them after an injury.
Atlanta plays 4, 4 and 3 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 14 back-to-backs, and resting players is not a concern.

durable.text: He struggled with his shot last season, but his longer track record shows a much better shooter.
He repeatedly dropped out of OKC's playoff rotation.

note: Aaron Wiggins is not a draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 249 and ESPN 227, both value him at 0 USD, and our league drafts only 144 players. The two projections disagree mostly on FG% (44.2 on Yahoo vs 48.7 on ESPN), so his value depends on whether his shooting returns toward his 48.8% from 2024-25. Early in the season, watch him on waivers for two things: minutes taken from Dort and an injury to an Atlanta starter.
